name: What damages can be claimed after a car accident in San Diego?

mainEntity.name: What damages can be claimed after a car accident in San Diego?

acceptedAnswer.text: After a car accident in San Diego, you can claim medical expenses, lost wages, vehicle repair costs, pain and suffering, and other out-of-pocket losses caused by another’s negligence.
